summary: The attack-path reports to Azure complete at the largest installations: every part is answered from the graph stored once per run.

new.title: Alert at the AI daily limit
new.text: When the AI daily limit is reached, Invardia receives an alert as well as the warning in the run log, so support sees it at once.

fixes.title: Attack-path reports use the stored graph
fixes.text: The two reports on devices with high-severity vulnerabilities that allow lateral movement to Azure answer every part from the graph SecurityInsight stores once per run, so they complete at the largest installations.

fixes.title: AI roles left alone while AI is off
fixes.text: With AI switched off, the update leaves the Azure OpenAI roles of the engine and web identities alone and does not mention them.
